contentText: The humanitarian crisis in Southern Lebanon is reaching a breaking point. As Prime Minister Netanyahu confirms plans to expand a military 'buffer zone' along the border, sweeping evacuation orders south of the Litani River have already forced over a million people to flee. Yet, thousands remain trapped behind the frontlines. Our correspondents, Mélina Huet and Achraf Abid, joined a rare humanitarian convoy into the restricted zone.
